title: Defining Page-Centric Visual Document Retrieval and Evaluating Existing Benchmarks
abstract: arXiv:2610.41360v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In modern information retrieval (IR), documents are increasingly encountered as structured sequences of visually rich, paginated units, rather than as flat text. Example documents encountered in our daily life include Word files, PDFs, and slide decks. Free text-centric retrieval systems either ignore this structure entirely or destroy it through arbitrary passage chunking. In this paper, we formulate page-centric Visual Document Retrieval (VDR) with pages as the fundamental indexing units and document context available for assessing page relevance. The formulation distinguishes two retrieval granularities, page and document, and three retrieval paradigms: independent-item, evidence-set, and iterative retrieval. We then assess 42 benchmarks using eight criteria covering corpus characteristics, query construction, relevance annotation, and ranking support. translated_title: 定义以页面为中心的视觉文档检索并评估现有基准测试
translated_abstract: 在现代信息检索（IR）中，文档越来越多地以视觉丰富、分页单元构成的结构化序列形式出现，而非扁平的纯文本。日常生活中常见的此类文档包括Word文件、PDF和幻灯片。以自由文本为中心的检索系统要么完全忽略这种结构，要么通过任意的段落切分将其破坏。在本文中，我们提出了以页面为中心的视觉文档检索（VDR）的形式化定义，将页面作为基本的索引单元，并利用文档上下文来评估页面相关性。该定义区分了两种检索粒度（页面级和文档级）以及三种检索范式：独立条目检索、证据集检索和迭代检索。随后，我们采用涵盖语料库特征、查询构建、相关性标注和排序支持等八个方面的评估标准，对42个基准测试进行了评估。我们的分析揭示了当前VDR研究的两个主要发现。首先，评估……
tldr: 本文提出了以页面为中心的视觉文档检索（VDR）的形式化框架，定义了页面与文档两种检索粒度以及独立条目、证据集和迭代三种检索范式，并基于八项标准系统评估了42个现有基准测试。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes page-centric Visual Document Retrieval (VDR) with two retrieval granularities and three retrieval paradigms, and systematically evaluates 42 existing benchmarks against eight criteria.
